en: A vintage colored postcard showing a large open square with a column topped by a statue in the foreground and several multi‑storey neoclassical buildings in the background. People stand and walk around the square. There are flagpoles with flags flying above the central and right‑hand buildings. The caption text in Greek and French/English at the top identifies the location as Themistocles Square in Piraeus. A website watermark appears at the bottom.
